title: Item 12b · Closing and opening sign-ups: the words and icons
subtitle: Approved in each section, plus some drift. Every list lets staff close sign-ups by hand and open them again — with three ways to say “open again” and two icon styles. Color Belt, Star and Black Belt: “Close registration / Open registration” (approved; Black Belt adds lock icons — approved in its mockups, but the icon map gives the locks to “Lock now” and Finance's “Reopen day”). Camps: “Close sign-up / Reopen sign-up” (approved, v0.700). Forms: “Close form” (approved) / “Open form again” with door icons (never decided — drift). (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

row.caption: 1. Color Belt (Star the same): “Close registration”, no icon.
2. Black Belt: the same words, with the lock icon that means “Lock now” elsewhere.
4. Forms, a closed form: “Open form again”, with a door icon that isn't in the icon map.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · one verb pair, no icons

row.caption: 5. Black Belt: “Close registration” without the lock (Registration links now sits in the header, item 12a).

columns.note: Copies what's already there: Color Belt's and Star's “Close … / Open …” with no icon. Each section keeps its own noun: registration (testing), sign-up (camps), form (Forms). Pictures 5–7 are drawn over the real menus; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − three ways to say “open again”; Black Belt's lock icons also mean “Lock now” and Finance's “Reopen day”.
B · Recommended: one verb pair, each section's own noun, no icons. “Close registration / Open registration” (Color Belt, Star, Black Belt), “Close sign-up / Open sign-up” (Camps), “Close form / Open form” (Forms); no icon on these items anywhere, as Color Belt, Star and Camps do today. + the same two verbs everywhere; the lock icons keep their own meanings (Lock now, Finance's day); the nouns still match what families do (register, sign up, fill in a form). − small rewording in Camps and Forms; Black Belt's approved lock icons go.
C · One phrase everywhere: “Close registration / Open registration”, Camps and Forms included. + identical words in every menu (Camps' button already says “Registration link”). − a free-class form isn't a registration, and Camps' family pages say “sign up”.
